content.answer: When updating an id-referenced single-select option list, always merge by stable id: pass each existing option object through unchanged (name keeps its old id), and assign fresh ids only to genuinely new names, continuing from max(existing id)+1 — never rebuild the list from names alone, because that creates new ids and silently clears every existing row's reference.
content.reuse_advice: For any catalog update where entries are referenced by id (e.g., select fields, tags, enums): fetch the current list first, diff it against the target, keep existing entries' ids and objects untouched, append only new entries with ids continuing from max(existing id)+1, and verify row references survive after the update.
